title: Two Different Regimens of Nolvadex in Preventing Gynecomastia Induced by Casodex 150 mg in Patients With Prostate Cancer
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to investigate the efficacy of different dosing and scheduling of Nolvadex in preventing gynecomastia/mastalgia induced by Casodex 150 mg monotherapy in patients with prostate cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically confirmed prostate cancer
* Locally advanced prostate cancer patients suitable for Casodex 150 mg monotherapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 75 yrs
* No metastatic disease (M1).
* No presence of gynaecomastia and/or mastalgia at screening
* No therapy with medications able to provoke gynaecomastia and/or mastalgia within 6 months of trial entry.
